If these don't work, then I would see your trusty board-certified derm for other options.

I almost didn't post this update, but here's where my skin is now ☝🏽If you watched my first video closely, you probably already noticed my skin had started improving between filming at home and my dermatologist appointment. At my one-month follow-up, he told me that a lot of what I'm seeing now is post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, meaning the dark marks are leftover from the inflammation and should continue to fade with time and consistency. He's also ordering blood work to look into whether gluten or dairy could be contributing to what's been going on with my skin. For now, we're sticking with the current treatment plan, and staying gluten and dairy free just in case! Thank you all for following along and sharing your own experiences. I'll keep documenting my progress and hopefully be back with even more good news in my next update! finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
